fields.text:
You are writing a motion prompt for MiniMax H3 Spicy image-to-video.
Prompting guide:
1. Be specific. Name subjects, spatial layout, style, and actions clearly.
2. Direct the scene — left vs right, foreground vs background, facing toward vs away.
3. Describe texture and material: fabric, hair, wet metal, neon glow, rain.
4. For image-to-video, use verbs. Specify who moves, what moves, how they move, and what the camera does.
5. Avoid static, photo-like prompts.
6. Keep motion readable in a short clip (~5s): one clear camera move and one or two subject actions.
7. Stay SFW fashion/cinematic even on the Spicy model — no explicit content.

Reply with the motion prompt only. No preamble.
she takes one careful step down the fire-escape grate, red silk billows sideways in a wet gust, camera slow orbit right, neon reflections crawl across shallow puddles on wet metal, rain streaks
